question: Nadaswaran instrument is played by _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nadhaswaram**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sheik Chinna Moulana** popularly known as **Sheik**, was a **prominent nadhaswaram player** in the tradition of Carnatic.
 
• He was felicited by the Madras Music Academy's **Sangeetha Kalanidhi** in **1998**
 
• Nadhaswaram__ is a double-reed wind instrument from South India.
 
• It is used as a traditional classical instrument in Tamilnadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Kerala.
